note: Goldens were cross-checked against an INDEPENDENT from-spec encoder, not round-tripped through the kernel: research/_x402-permit2-oracle.mjs implements the generic typed-data algorithm over type definitions supplied as data (recursive encodeType with the alphabetical ordering rule for referenced types, recursive hashStruct), while the kernel concatenates words by hand for three fixed message shapes. The two agree on domain_separator, struct_hash and digest for all three goldens. The same run re-derives the nine canonical typehashes from their ASCII strings and matches the pinned table, re-derives the three Permit2 type strings from the type definitions and matches the literals the on-chain library hashes, proves that injecting a domain version moves the digest and that swapping the appended referenced types moves the typehash, and recovers the handoff record back to the signer it names. human_sign_off: PENDING.
